title: What is a stock?
goal: A stock is a small piece of a company that you can own.

objectives.text: Know that a stock price can go up or down.

slides.text: Picture a big pie. Cut it into small slices. A company can be cut like that.
slides.title: Think of a pie

slides.text: A stock is a small piece of a company that you can own. Each slice of the pie is a piece.
slides.title: Stocks

slides.text: One unit of a stock is called a share. If you own 10 shares, you own 10 slices.
slides.title: Shares

slides.text: When you own a stock, you are a part owner. The price of your slice can go up or down.
slides.title: Part owner

options.text: A small piece of a company

questions.explanation: A stock is a small piece of a company that you can own.

questions.prompt: A share is one unit of a stock.
questions.explanation: Yes. Own 10 shares and you own 10 small pieces.

questions.prompt: You own 3 shares. What do you own?
questions.explanation: Each share is one small piece.

questions.prompt: A stock price can only go up.
questions.explanation: No. A stock price can go up or down. That is why stocks have risk.
A stock is a small piece of a company.
